## Change summary

Describe the behavior, contract, schema, and operational impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `yarn validate` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover success, failure, authorization, tenant isolation, and idempotency where applicable.
- [ ] Logs and fixtures contain no credentials, tokens, BVN, NIN, or personal data.
- [ ] Contract changes are versioned in `parc-contracts`.
- [ ] Schema changes have migration, backfill, validation, and forward-fix analysis.
- [ ] No cross-service database access or source imports were introduced.

## Review and rollout

List dependencies, deployment order, feature flags, monitoring, rollback/forward-fix plan, and required approvals.
